comparison.objective: Measure and mark 300 mm on a board with a spring-return tape.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a tape extended against spring return while the other hand places a precise pen mark.
comparison.success_condition: A single released-pen mark is within 4 mm of 300 mm while the tape was extended beyond it; success holds for 1 second.
comparison.reason: This tests sustained bimanual measurement and marking, not setting retention or dynamic impact tuning.
